report_parsed.summary: Within the authorized 300s window (2026-09-27T07:35:47Z–07:40:47Z) checkout is failing: every sampled oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span is marked error with otel.status_code ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code 13, carrying status_description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'. The failing edge is checkout -> payment: checkout's outbound oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge spans error with rpc.grpc.status_code 2, and payment service spans raise the same 'Invalid token' error, with a stacktrace pointing at charge.js. Metrics corroborate: checkout server PlaceOrder carries rpc_grpc_status_code 13 at ~7.5-10 per 300s while status 0 is 0, and payment shows STATUS_CODE_ERROR span calls. Dependency services other than payment show no error tags and gRPC status 0 in all sampled spans (product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping), and HTTP 200 at frontend-proxy. On latency, sampled dependency call durations are all low (sub-100ms, e.g. checkout client p95 GetQuote ~22ms, Convert ~8-16ms), so the available evidence shows failures, not elevated latency, on those paths; however no pre-window baseline was collected, so no latency trend can be asserted. Email returned no_data, so its state is unknown rather than confirmed healthy.

claims.text: All 10 sampled checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans in the window are error spans with otel.status_code ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code 13, and the status description repeatedly reads 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'. Trace ids: e65541b8e0a164d5264e58be6dbbbebe, 835dc7d3f4a0cdac191489bb92188613, 0b6fe156b3282631b20357105825d460, 8f81a7af2dac77b7cfbec083f8196f11, d0b5851ba883b955d177fd9f88b0802b, a244ee64e19c5dcea8610712ff158f40, 4363fa88e713b9126e52967eed545c61, 12c179e9a2bd1178149b4bc09f1dceb8, e027089a926363317365999f655aa504, 1a26bb9c6d944c94e74a0550a4b36708.

Checkout's outbound oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge spans error with rpc.grpc.status_code 2 and status description 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' (e.g. spans 2e021cd321e39e1d in trace e65541b8e0a164d5264e58be6dbbbebe and e04416b76200d771 in trace 8f81a7af2dac77b7cfbec083f8196f11), and payment service spans raise the same error with grpc.error_name Error and a charge.js:37 stacktrace (spans fee23072dbae8713, ccdecc1b5b6cf47c, 3ad140c86700ee89).

Checkout server-side gRPC counts in the window show oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder with rpc_grpc_status_code 13 at rates 7.499781256380023 then 10.000041666840279 (per 300s) while rpc_grpc_status_code 0 for PlaceOrder is 0 at both steps, i.e. no successful checkout server calls were recorded in the metrics.

Span-call metrics over the window show checkout span_name oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge under status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR at 7.500031250130209 then 8.749963541818577 (per 300s), with the STATUS_CODE_UNSET series for those same spans at 0, and payment span_name grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge STATUS_CODE_ERROR at the same values.

Service-level span-call metrics show checkout status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR 15.000062500260418 then 17.499927083637154 and payment STATUS_CODE_ERROR 7.500031250130209 then 8.749963541818577, while cart, product-catalog, shipping and email have no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series returned.

Frontend traces show the checkout failure propagating upstream: span 501e33a9b1d91e9c (trace 0b6fe156b3282631b20357105825d460) is an error POST with http.status_code 500, and span fa677d60377fab84 in the same trace is an error client span for grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder with rpc.grpc.status_code 13 and grpc.error_message '13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card: ... Payment request failed. Invalid token.'

Sampled product-catalog spans show no error tags and rpc.grpc.status_code 0 with durations in the low milliseconds (maximum observed 5203 us for span 58d58cf7ea05c9bc), and product-catalog server counts show GetProduct status 0 at 128.74409922878536 then 120.00050000208334 and ListProducts status 0 at 19.999083375345297 then 12.500052083550347.

Sampled cart spans carry no error tags; GetCart/AddItem spans are mostly a few milliseconds, with one outlier span 3275ac295ddecfce (POST /oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, trace 0d835f711c7f58071a1aa27cdff104e4) at 90928 us containing a child HMSET span 8731200862c4bcee at 64234 us.

Sampled shipping spans carry no error tags: oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote spans report rpc.grpc.status_code 0 and their child POST spans report http.status_code 200, with durations from 3786 us up to 16001 us.

Sampled currency spans (operation Currency/Convert, e.g. spans cae848b878416254, 45c8b86f03aebfe5, 8424b7712e69b32c) carry no error tags, report otel.status_code OK and rpc.grpc.status_code 0, with durations from a few hundred microseconds up to 5596 us.

Frontend-proxy sampled spans report http.status_code 200 with no error tags; the largest observed proxy span is ingress dfc0c440c1033388 at 410189 us (trace 234608ad8a5e8244d57ddc4387e5bb46), with no error status recorded.

Checkout client-side latency aggregates in the window are low and do not exceed roughly 23 ms at the two reported steps: average client duration 2.959->2.827 ms for CurrencyService/Convert, 1.745->1.950 ms for CartService/GetCart, 0.927->0.606 ms for ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, 8.582->8.658 ms for ShippingService/GetQuote, and 10.406->8.873 ms for the failing PaymentService/Charge (status 2). The checkout 95th-percentile client series show Convert 8.5->16.375 ms, GetCart 4.75->8.0 ms, GetQuote 22.75->22.0 ms, Charge(status 2) 22.75->22.0 ms, GetProduct 4.75->4.75 ms, while Charge(status 0), EmptyCart and ShipOrder are NaN.
Server-side 95th-percentile duration in the window is 48.125->64.99999999999999 ms for checkout PlaceOrder, and 4.75 ms for both product-catalog GetProduct and ListProducts at both steps.

The observed checkout failures are caused by payment's Charge rejecting requests with 'Invalid token' (the error text is identical in checkout client spans, payment server spans and the frontend's propagated 500/grpc-13 error), making the checkout error a downstream consequence of the payment failure rather than an independent checkout fault.

Against an 'elevated latency' explanation: the checkout-to-dependency client durations and the dependency server spans in this window are all small (checkout client p95 at most ~22 ms on the Charge(2)/GetQuote paths, product-catalog server p95 4.75 ms, shipping GetQuote <=16 ms, currency Convert <=5.6 ms), and the only large sampled spans are frontend/frontend-proxy page-render spans with http.status_code 200, so the observed checkout failures are accompanied by error statuses rather than high latency on those dependency paths.

Rejected as unsupported by the sampled views: that product-catalog, cart, currency or shipping were themselves returning errors during the window — no sampled span from these services carried an error tag, and their recorded gRPC status codes were 0 (with HTTP 200 for shipping's child POST spans).

Human follow-up should inspect the payment dependency's token validation path and the 'app.loyalty.level=gold' feature-flag context referenced in the error text, and only then decide whether any remediation is warranted; this report authorizes no change.

gaps: Email: traces_search for service 'email' returned status no_data with zero results in this window, so email health, call volume and latency are unknown — not zero and not confirmed healthy.
No comparable pre-window baseline was collected, so no latency trend can be inferred for checkout or any dependency; the two in-window steps alone do not establish a trend.

Trace coverage is partial: several views are flagged incomplete (product-catalog, cart, frontend, frontend-proxy) and the checkout and payment trace views were truncated with omitted rows (checkout returned 16 of 20 with 4 omitted rows; payment returned 12 of 20 with 8 omitted rows), so the failure set shown is a sample and span counts are not unique request counts.

Most sampled spans have parent_is_visible=false on their parent reference (e.g. checkout PlaceOrder parents, payment's Charge parents), so a complete checkout->payment->downstream call chain cannot be reconstructed from this evidence, and the checkout payment client edge is only visible for a subset of spans where the parent reference points to a visible checkout span.

No metric series was returned for cart/currency/shipping/product-catalog error status codes, so absence of those series is unknown rather than proof of zero errors; likewise no ERROR-level series was found for email.

Whether checkout's internal spans (e.g. cart ClearCart, order publish, ShipOrder) executed at all on failing orders is unobserved: EmptyCart, ShipOrder, 'HTTP POST' and 'orders publish' span counts were 0 in the span-call metrics, which may reflect the failure aborting those steps or may reflect missing instrumentation.
next_steps: Inspect the payment service charge logic and its token/feature-flag inputs (the error references app.loyalty.level=gold) to determine why Charge returns 'Invalid token' at error rate ~7.5-10 per 300s.
Query email service telemetry with a different selector to determine whether it was emitting spans during this window, since its trace search returned no_data.
Collect a pre-incident baseline window for checkout and payment call/error/latency metrics to establish whether any latency change accompanied the error increase.
Review frontend /api/checkout 500 responses over a longer window to quantify user-visible impact beyond the 300-second authorized range.
